The kind of error (SD/SE) is not stated for this value. Check against the series: 4.0 x exp(-0.07/(R x 298.15 K)) = 3.55, printed 3.5: reproduced. The 3.0 ± 0.1 at 25 °C in the same paragraph is the pre-steady-state KIE of Benkovic and co-workers (refs 3, 33) and was not entered (rule 1).
